name: @local/dsh-git-actions
description: Guarded git workflow commands for DSH sessions: /draft-commit drafts a commit message and prints it (committing and pushing happen only when you ask); /draft-pr drafts a pull-request title and body the same way; /create-branch-from verifies the source branch (offering similar branches when the name misses) and creates the new branch; /setup-protect-branch-hook installs git hooks so main is never touched and release/* pushes require an explicit parameter. Never touches main; release/* origin changes are always confirmed.
